description: This header file defines the 'AudioCompression' class within the 'device' namespace. The class is designed to manage different levels of audio compression, providing static constants for various compression types, singleton-like getInstance methods, and constructors/destructors. It includes references to 'dsConstant.hpp' and uses standard C++ features such as classes, static members, and namespaces.

classes.name: AudioCompression
classes.description: Extends DSConstant for implementing AudioCompression levels. Provides static constants for different compression types, singleton access methods, and constructors/destructors.
